scenes.text: Rome did not fall in a day. It took centuries.
By the fourth century, the empire was split in two.
In the west, the legions were recalled, and the frontier was left open.
In four seventy-six, a boy emperor was deposed. No one called it an ending.
The empire fell. But the idea of Rome never did.
